traceability.evidence: Story file verified: docs/stories/004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS.story.md (content matches the specification provided in the prompt)., Core rule implementation: src/rules/require-branch-annotation.ts - Defines ESLint RuleModule `require-branch-annotation`. - JSDoc links to story 004.0 and requirements REQ-BRANCH-DETECTION and REQ-CONFIGURABLE-SCOPE. - meta: { type: 'problem', fixable: 'code', docs.description: 'Require @story and @req annotations on code branches', schema supports branchTypes option }. - create(context): • Uses validateBranchTypes(context) to validate / derive branchTypes. • If validateBranchTypes returns a listener (invalid config), returns it directly (config error behavior). • Otherwise builds handlers for each configured branch type that call reportMissingAnnotations(context, node, storyFixCountRef). • Skips default SwitchCase (no test) via `if (type === 'SwitchCase' && node.test == null) return;`., Branch-type significance and configurability (REQ-SIGNIFICANCE-CRITERIA, REQ-CONFIGURABLE-SCOPE): src/utils/branch-annotation-helpers.ts - DEFAULT_BRANCH_TYPES (annotated with REQ-SIGNIFICANCE-CRITERIA): ["IfStatement", "SwitchCase", "TryStatement", "CatchClause", "ForStatement", "ForOfStatement", "ForInStatement", "WhileStatement", "DoWhileStatement"]. - validateBranchTypes(context) (annotated with REQ-CONFIGURABLE-SCOPE): • If options.branchTypes is a valid subset of DEFAULT_BRANCH_TYPES, returns that array. • If any invalid types are present, returns a RuleListener { Program } that reports each invalid type with message: `Value "${t}" should be equal to one of the allowed values: ${DEFAULT_BRANCH_TYPES.join(', ')}`. • If branchTypes is not provided, returns DEFAULT_BRANCH_TYPES array., Comment association and annotation parsing (REQ-COMMENT-ASSOCIATION, REQ-ANNOTATION-PARSING, REQ-SUPPORTS-ALTERNATIVE): src/utils/branch-annotation-helpers.ts - gatherBranchCommentText(sourceCode, node, parent) (annotated with REQ-COMMENT-ASSOCIATION): • For SwitchCase: scans preceding lines up to PRE_COMMENT_OFFSET, collecting comment lines. • For other nodes: uses sourceCode.getCommentsBefore(node) and specialized paths for CatchClause and IfStatement (else-if) to associate comments that might be inside blocks or in formatter-driven positions. - CatchClause handling via gatherCatchClauseCommentText(): • Prefers comments before catch if they contain @story/@req. • Else tries sourceCode.getCommentsInside(node.body); if that fails, falls back to line-based scan inside the catch block (supports Prettier behavior). - Else-if handling via gatherElseIfCommentText() and helpers: • Recognizes else-if branches (isElseIfBranch). • Precedence order: comments before else-if line → comments between condition and block → first comment-only lines inside the block. - getBranchAnnotationInfo(sourceCode, node, parent) (annotated with REQ-ANNOTATION-PARSING and REQ-SUPPORTS-ALTERNATIVE): • Uses gatherBranchCommentText to obtain comment text for the branch. • hasSupports = /@supports\b/.test(text). • missingStory = !/@story\b/.test(text) && !hasSupports. • missingReq = !/@req\b/.test(text) && !hasSupports. • Thus any @supports comment is treated as satisfying both story and requirement (REQ-SUPPORTS-ALTERNATIVE)., Reporting and auto-fix behavior (REQ-ANNOTATION-PARSING, User Experience): src/utils/branch-annotation-helpers.ts - reportMissingStory(context, node, { indent, insertPos, storyFixCountRef }): • On first missing-story occurrence (storyFixCountRef.count === 0), reports with messageId 'missingAnnotation', data { missing: '@story' }, and an auto-fix inserting `// @story .story.md` at the correct location. • Subsequent missing-story reports for the same file do not auto-fix (still report messageId+data), avoiding duplicate fix insertions. - reportMissingReq(context, node, { indent, insertPos, missingStory }): • If story is present (missingStory === false), reports messageId 'missingAnnotation', data { missing: '@req' } with auto-fix inserting `// @req `. • If story is also missing, reports without fix so that the rule does not insert a req above an as-yet-unfixed story. - meta.messages.missingAnnotation in src/rules/require-branch-annotation.ts: • Message: "Branch is missing required annotation: {{missing}}." — clearly indicates the branch and which annotation is missing, satisfying the User Experience acceptance criterion., Nested branch handling and complex control flow (REQ-NESTED-HANDLING): - Rule applies uniformly to all configured branch node types via handlers[type] = branchHandler. - getBranchAnnotationInfo uses parent linkage to handle else-if specially and align fix position with Prettier-style formatting. - Tests verify nested branches and else-if behavior (see test evidence below)., Tests for require-branch-annotation core behavior and configuration: tests/rules/require-branch-annotation.test.ts - File header explicitly traces to story 004.0 and requirements REQ-BRANCH-DETECTION, REQ-NESTED-HANDLING, REQ-SUPPORTS-ALTERNATIVE, etc. - Valid cases (selected): • "[REQ-BRANCH-DETECTION] valid if-statement with annotations" – verifies a preceding @story/@req pair is accepted. • "[REQ-BRANCH-DETECTION] valid for loop with block comment annotations" – verifies block comments immediately above loop are accepted. • "[REQ-BRANCH-DETECTION] valid switch-case with annotations" – verifies switch case annotations. • "[REQ-BRANCH-DETECTION] valid try-finally with annotations". • "[REQ-BRANCH-DETECTION] valid catch with annotations" (both try and catch annotated). • "[REQ-BRANCH-DETECTION] valid do-while / for-of / for-in / while loops with annotations". • "[REQ-NESTED-HANDLING] nested if-statements with annotations on outer and inner branches" – verifies nested branch handling. • "[REQ-BRANCH-DETECTION] valid default case without annotations" – codifies significance criteria that default case can be un-annotated. • "[REQ-CONFIGURABLE-SCOPE] custom branchTypes ignores unlisted branch types" – when branchTypes = ["IfStatement"], switch cases are not enforced. • "[REQ-CONFIGURABLE-SCOPE] custom branchTypes only enforce listed types". • Three valid tests for REQ-SUPPORTS-ALTERNATIVE where only @supports comments exist on if, try/catch, and else-if branches — proving @supports alone is sufficient. - Invalid cases (selected): • "[REQ-BRANCH-DETECTION] missing annotations on if-statement" – expects two missingAnnotation messages (for '@story' and '@req') and auto-fix inserting @story placeholder. • "[REQ-BRANCH-DETECTION] missing @req on for loop when only story present" – ensures separate detection of missing req. • "[REQ-BRANCH-DETECTION] missing @story on while loop when only req present". • "[REQ-BRANCH-DETECTION] missing annotations on switch-case / do-while / for-of / for-in / try-catch" – validates all branch types. • "[REQ-NESTED-HANDLING] missing annotations on nested if-statement inside annotated outer branch" – ensures inner missing branch still gets reported. • "[REQ-CONFIGURABLE-SCOPE] missing annotations on configured branch type ForStatement" – proves branchTypes configuration is honored. • "[REQ-PRETTIER-AUTOFIX-ELSE-IF] missing annotations on else-if branch with Prettier-style autofix insertion" – ensures else-if auto-fix behavior, message counts for both branches. - Additional runRule call tests invalid branchTypes option: • name: "[REQ-CONFIGURABLE-SCOPE] invalid branchTypes option should error schema" with options [{ branchTypes: ["UnknownType"] }]; expects error message matching /should be equal to one of the allowed values/ — validating configuration error handling., Helper tests for configuration and error messages: tests/utils/branch-annotation-helpers.test.ts - Directly tests validateBranchTypes() behavior aligned with REQ-CONFIGURABLE-SCOPE: • Returns DEFAULT_BRANCH_TYPES when no options provided. • Returns custom branchTypes when valid options provided. • When invalid branchTypes provided, returns a listener with Program handler that, when invoked, calls context.report once per invalid type with message containing 'Value "" should be equal to one of the allowed values:' — exactly as specified in the story’s invalid configuration behavior., Helper tests for comment association and branch positions (REQ-COMMENT-ASSOCIATION, REQ-NESTED-HANDLING, advanced positions): - tests/utils/branch-annotation-catch-position.test.ts (seen in Jest output): • Verifies CatchClause annotations before catch and inside catch body are recognized and precedence rules hold. - tests/utils/branch-annotation-else-if-position.test.ts (seen in Jest output): • Tests detection of @story/@req placed before else-if, between condition and block, and inside the block, ensuring precedence and fallback logic. - tests/utils/branch-annotation-else-if-insert-position.test.ts (seen in Jest output): • Verifies that auto-fix for else-if inserts annotations as first comment-only line inside the block, aligning with Prettier behavior. - These tests are referenced and explained in docs/rules/require-branch-annotation.md, confirming the documented behavior is implemented and tested., Performance and large-file behavior (REQ-PERFORMANCE-OPTIMIZATION): tests/perf/require-branch-annotation-large-file.test.ts - traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria and technical requirements for Story 004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS are fully implemented and verified. The ESLint rule `require-branch-annotation` exists, is wired into the plugin, supports @story/@req and @supports, handles all specified branch types (if/else, try/catch, switch cases, loops), supports configurable scope and invalid configuration errors, includes clear error messaging and auto-fix behavior, is documented with examples and configuration, and has comprehensive unit, integration, and performance tests that all pass under the current test run.
